incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A flooded city square with multi-story buildings submerged up to their ground floors by brown water.

observations.description: Brown water covering the entire square, reaching the base of buildings.
Multi-story buildings with storefronts and windows, some with balconies.

not_determinable: water depth relative to building features
scale of flood relative to street width
